hbs.label: HBS / BCG field experiment - 2023
hbs.scope: 758 BCG consultants; knowledge-work tasks using GPT-4. Benefits refer to tasks inside the tested capability frontier, not audit accuracy.

iia.label: The IIA - AI Auditing Framework - 2024
iia.scope: Professional guidance. The audit canvas and examples in this deck are teaching syntheses, not a reproduction of the official framework.

nist.label: NIST - AI RMF 1.0 - 2023
nist.scope: Voluntary framework: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. Use the 1.0 edition explicitly; it is under revision.

nist-gen.label: NIST - Generative AI Profile - 2024
nist-gen.scope: Cross-sector guidance on generative AI risks; not proof that a particular product is safe.

erm.label: NC State / AICPA - State of Risk Oversight - 2026
erm.scope: Among 331 executive and board-level respondents, 11% reported a unique strategic or competitive advantage from risk management. The 89% is its rounded complement, not a measure of failure or causal impact.

rsm.label: RSM · Middle Market AI Survey · 2026
rsm.scope: U.S./Canada study: 1,030 respondents from organisations already using AI, including pilots. The 86% integration and 36% fully-embedded figures describe this sample; they do not measure adoption across all businesses or in Indonesia.

rsm-method.label: RSM · Survey methodology · 2026
rsm-method.scope: Fieldwork 5–16 March 2026: 827 U.S. and 203 Canadian respondents, management level or above with influence over technology investment. Government and nonprofits excluded. All participating organisations already used AI.

gias.label: The IIA · Global Internal Audit Standards · 2024
gias.scope: 2024 edition, effective January 2025. References include Standards 4.3, 11.5, 13.2, 14.1–14.4 and 15.2. The deck paraphrases selected implications for internal audit; it does not replace the Standards or prescribe financial-statement audit requirements.

iso.label: ISO/IEC 42001 · AI management systems · 2023
iso.scope: Official ISO overview of the AI management system standard. Organisational governance requirements are distinct from proof of a model’s accuracy. No certification or clause-by-clause conformance conclusion is made in this seminar.

coso.label: COSO · ERM: Strategy & Performance · 2017
coso.scope: COSO connects enterprise risk management with strategy setting and performance. The feedback diagram is an RSM seminar explanation of that connection, not a reproduction of COSO’s official framework or an endorsement of a scoring method.

agents.label: Anthropic · Building effective agents · 2024
agents.scope: Engineering guidance distinguishing predefined workflows from model-directed tool use. Used for the architectural distinction, not a benchmark, audit standard or claim that autonomy is always preferable.

pcaob.label: PCAOB staff · GenAI outreach · 2024
pcaob.scope: July 2024 staff observations from limited U.S. audit-firm and preparer outreach, especially pp. 4–5. Historical practice evidence, not a Board rule, a current adoption survey, or Indonesian audit requirements.

rsm-regional.label: RSM · The responsible auditor
rsm-regional.scope: RSM regional practitioner discussion with Indonesian participation: AI governance, accountability, human oversight and audit capability. Thought leadership, not a quantitative study.

secure-ai.label: NCSC · Secure AI development
secure-ai.scope: Secure design, development, deployment and operation guidance. Supports threat modelling, access, monitoring and lifecycle controls; it does not guarantee confidentiality or certify the reference architecture.

data-disclosure.label: OWASP · Sensitive data disclosure · 2025
data-disclosure.scope: LLM02:2025. Data sanitisation, least privilege, source restriction and disclosure risk. A control in a prompt or a redaction step is not a complete privacy guarantee.

prompt-injection.label: OWASP · Prompt injection · 2025
prompt-injection.scope: LLM01:2025. Untrusted content can redirect an LLM application; controls must address the application, tools and permissions rather than relying on a system prompt alone.

agent-security.label: OpenAI · Agent approvals & security
agent-security.scope: Product-specific guidance on agent permissions, sandboxing and command networking. Shell restrictions do not establish offline model inference or cover every hosted search, app or MCP path. Diagrams simplify these distinctions for general audiences; they do not reproduce the exact interface.

work-data.label: OpenAI · ChatGPT Work enterprise overview
work-data.scope: Enterprise/Edu Work documentation: conversations, uploaded files, memory and connected sources can have distinct retention and deletion lifecycles. Not a universal consumer ChatGPT or API policy.

claude-data.label: Anthropic · Claude Code data usage
claude-data.scope: Claude Code documentation distinguishes consumer and commercial data use, model-improvement choices and feedback/session-sharing. Conditions depend on the account and feature; not a statement of every provider’s terms.

claude-permissions.label: Anthropic · Claude Code permissions
claude-permissions.scope: Supported tool permissions, file-read restrictions and scopes. Read-only, working directory and gitignore are not interchangeable privacy boundaries; verify the actual tool configuration.

claude-faq.label: Anthropic · Claude Code user FAQ
claude-faq.scope: Primary product explanation: CLI tools can read local source content and send it to hosted inference. This is specific to cloud-backed Claude Code use, not every local agent or offline model.

nist-trust.label: NIST · Trustworthy AI characteristics
nist-trust.scope: AI RMF 1.0 section 3 and Figure 4. Seven interconnected qualities, with validity/reliability as a foundation and accountability/transparency across the others. Context and trade-offs matter; this is not an audit certification checklist.

api-data.label: OpenAI · API data controls
api-data.scope: API-specific documentation reviewed 13 November 2026: API data is not used for training by default unless opted in. Retention and processing controls are separate. Do not apply this statement to every personal chatbot account or feature.

echoleak.label: Microsoft MSRC — CVE-2025-32711
echoleak.scope: Vendor advisory for a resolved M365 Copilot information-disclosure vulnerability. This case establishes a real AI attack surface, not evidence of a confirmed customer breach.

rsm-ia.label: RSM Indonesia — Internal Audit
rsm-ia.scope: Public RSM Indonesia internal-audit service information. Specific AI penetration-testing and AI-supported assessment capabilities are supplied by the RSM presenters, not independently demonstrated by this brochure.

nvidia-local.label: NVIDIA — Self-hosted RAG Blueprint
nvidia-local.scope: Technical deployment reference for self-hosted, on-premises RAG components. The location diagram is a teaching architecture, not a security certification or a claim that RAG prevents retention or training.

ms-analytics.label: Microsoft Research — Natural-language data analytics
ms-analytics.scope: Research into turning natural-language questions into analysis programs. Supports a changed interaction model, not a claim that LLMs eliminate statistical testing or are accurate on every analytical task.

sklearn-evaluation.label: scikit-learn — Cross-validation and model evaluation
sklearn-evaluation.scope: Documentation on evaluating models with held-out data and cross-validation. Supports the distinction between exploratory LLM assistance and validated predictive modelling.

antara-tariff.label: ANTARA — Indonesia kena kenaikan tarif AS 32 persen
antara-tariff.scope: Historical reporting of the April 2025 US tariff announcement. Not a current tariff rate. Company names, portfolio shares and impacts in the exercise are fictional context; the article does not establish a loss for either organisation.

pwc-alignment.label: PwC - Global Internal Audit Study 2023
pwc-alignment.scope: 49% of business executives perceived a lack of strong alignment between internal audit and other lines on key risks and problems. The overall study covered 4,680 respondents in 81 countries; that total is not the denominator for this subgroup percentage.

iiba-analysis.label: IIBA - Needs, solutions, requirements and designs
iiba-analysis.scope: Business analysis connects stakeholder needs and context to solutions that deliver value. Used as conceptual guidance, not a quantified claim about AI investment returns.

citizen-development.label: OWASP - Citizen Development Top 10
citizen-development.scope: Security and governance risks in low-code/no-code, AI-assisted coding and AI-agent development. The seminar applies this guidance to employee and branch applications; it does not claim that every such application is insecure.

slides.title: General use of AI
slides.lead: Familiar tools. Protected information. A new starting point for analysis.
slides.notes: Ini hanya penyegaran, bukan pelatihan memakai alat. Kenalkan dua cara yang sudah lazim: chatbot di web dan agent, misalnya melalui CLI. narrative.question: AI, briefly.
narrative.transition: Two familiar ways to use it. One question: what happens to our information?

slides.notesEn: Start with two familiar ways to work: a chatbot and an agent, for example through a CLI. Ask where information goes, then identify practical safeguards before moving to the two audit perspectives.

slides.title: How AI is generally used nowadays
slides.lead: A quick refresh—not a tool tutorial.
slides.notes:
Pembuka ini sengaja singkat. Chatbot web menerima pertanyaan atau attachment dan mengembalikan jawaban; beberapa chatbot juga mempunyai tools. Agen, misalnya melalui CLI, dapat membaca file dan menjalankan langkah sesuai izin. CLI hanyalah antarmuka; ia tidak otomatis berarti offline atau model lokal. Jangan menganggap kedua kategori terpisah mutlak. Fokus pada tindakan pengguna dan akses yang diberikan, bukan definisi teknis panjang.

Pertanyaan: A chatbot you talk to. An agent you give a task to. Penghubung: A quick refresh—not a tool tutorial.

narrative.question: A chatbot you talk to. An agent you give a task to.
narrative.transition: A quick refresh—not a tool tutorial.

slides.notesEn:
A chatbot receives questions and shared content. An agent can also use files and tools within its permissions. These categories overlap: the important questions are what it can read, send and do.

Anthropic · Building effective agents · 2024: Engineering guidance distinguishing predefined workflows from model-directed tool use. Used for the architectural distinction, not a benchmark, audit standard or claim that autonomy is always preferable.

OpenAI · Agent approvals & security: Product-specific guidance on agent permissions, sandboxing and command networking. Shell restrictions do not establish offline model inference or cover every hosted search, app or MCP path. Diagrams simplify these distinctions for general audiences; they do not reproduce the exact interface.

slides.title: The impact of AI on data analytics workflows
slides.lead: From operating every technical step to giving AI the task.
slides.notes: Bandingkan pekerjaan yang terlihat oleh pengguna. Sebelumnya analis menjalankan perumusan tugas, persiapan data, pemilihan model, pelatihan, pengujian dan penyajian. Pada contoh LLM-first, pengguna menjelaskan analisis yang diinginkan lewat prompt dan agent menangani pembacaan, alat, analisis serta visualisasi. Animasi berulang menunjukkan pekerjaan teknis berpindah ke belakang prompt. Ini ilustrasi alur analisis dokumen dan data sehari-hari, bukan klaim bahwa semua pemodelan prediktif menjadi tugas yang sama atau metode teknis tidak diperlukan. Jelaskan pembedaan itu secara lisan tanpa memenuhi slide dengan detail evaluasi model.
slides.notesEn: Compare the work visible to the user. Previously the analyst operated task definition, data preparation, model selection, training, testing and presentation. In the LLM-first example, the user describes the desired analysis in a prompt and the agent handles reading, tools, analysis and visualisation. The animation repeats the technical work moving behind the prompt. This is a workflow illustration for everyday document and data analysis, not a claim that all predictive modelling becomes the same task or that technical methods cease to exist. Keep that distinction in the spoken explanation rather than crowding the slide with model-evaluation details.

narrative.question: The question comes first. The model-building can wait.
narrative.transition: For many everyday analyses, a pretrained LLM changes the starting point.

slides.title: Chatbots, AI agents and agentic AI
slides.lead: From answering a question to coordinating work toward an objective.
slides.notes: Ini pembedaan praktis, bukan taksonomi universal. Chatbot merespons percakapan. Agent beralat dapat bertindak dan memeriksa hasil. Sistem agentic mengendalikan rencana lebih panjang, mengoordinasikan alat atau agent khusus dan menyesuaikan langkah berdasarkan umpan balik. Satu agent pun dapat bersifat agentic; banyak agent tidak otomatis bermanfaat atau andal. Arc animasi menunjukkan aliran informasi dan umpan balik, bukan kewenangan tanpa batas. Manusia tetap menetapkan akses, kondisi berhenti dan gerbang persetujuan. Diagram adalah sintesis pembelajaran, sedangkan Anthropic menjadi rujukan pembedaan arsitektur workflow dan agent.
slides.notesEn: These are practical distinctions, not a universally agreed taxonomy. A chatbot responds in conversation. A tool-using agent can take actions and inspect results. An agentic system controls a longer plan, coordinates tools or specialised agents and adapts from feedback. One agent can be agentic; several agents do not automatically make a useful or reliable system. The animated arcs show information and feedback, not unrestricted authority. People still define access, stop conditions and approval gates. The diagram is an original teaching synthesis inspired by the supplied visual; Anthropic provides the workflow/agent architectural distinction.

slides.title: Data processing in chatbots and AI agents
slides.lead: Unapproved sharing can expose confidential information outside your organisation.
slides.notes:
Pilih Chatbot atau CLI pada diagram untuk menyegarkan dua pola penggunaan. Animasi biru menunjukkan copy/teks keluar, hijau jawaban kembali; original tetap terlihat. Bukan semua agen memakai hosted inference, namun lokasi CLI tidak membuktikan data tetap lokal. Cloud bukan publik dan diagram tidak menetapkan negara penyimpanan. Inference, retensi dan training merupakan pertanyaan berbeda. Jawaban kembali tidak otomatis menghapus salinan layanan. Tidak perlu menjelaskan token, sandbox, RAG atau stdout kepada audiens umum.

Pertanyaan: Where does the information go? Penghubung: The original may stay on your computer while a copy or selected information goes online.

Tekankan jalur keluar berwarna merah: file asli yang tetap lokal tidak berarti informasinya tetap lokal. Pembagian tanpa izin atas catatan klien, data pribadi atau temuan merupakan risiko pengungkapan. Pemrosesan cloud yang sah bukan dengan sendirinya bukti kebocoran. Periksa unggahan chatbot dan hak akses alat/agent ke folder.

slides.title: Data protection when using AI
slides.lead: A model-improvement opt-out is one safeguard. It does not remove the other checks.
slides.notes:
Safeguard umum: pakai akun/layanan yang disetujui, matikan penggunaan untuk model improvement bila tersedia, verifikasi aturan akun yang berlaku, minimalkan dokumen, batasi folder/konektor/penerima, periksa penyimpanan dan penghapusan, serta review hasil. Pengaturan yang digambar merupakan ilustrasi, bukan screenshot atau jaminan nama menu tertentu. Pada layanan yang menawarkan model-improvement opt-out, penolakan training tidak berarti tidak dikirim online, tidak disimpan, atau tidak dapat diakses processor. Ketentuan consumer, workspace bisnis dan API dapat berbeda. OpenAI API tidak memakai data untuk training secara default kecuali opt-in; jangan menerapkan aturan API itu otomatis ke akun chatbot personal. Tidak perlu mengubah setting akun peserta saat presentasi. Jangan upload dokumen terlarang meskipun training off.

Pertanyaan: Share deliberately. Check the account, not just the tool. Penghubung: A model-improvement opt-out is one safeguard. It does not remove the other checks.

For sensitive tasks, the next slides examine an entirely on-premises deployment and explain what RAG does and does not do.

slides.title: On-premises AI for sensitive information
slides.lead: A conservative data-location choice: an entirely on-premises AI workflow.
slides.notes:
Alur on-premise dapat mempertahankan pemrosesan dalam kendali infrastruktur organisasi dengan antarmuka chatbot atau agent yang tetap familiar. Ini pilihan konservatif untuk lokasi data, bukan klaim bahwa setiap sistem on-premise lebih aman daripada setiap layanan cloud. Jalankan retrieval, embedding, inferensi dan layanan pendukung secara lokal; batasi koneksi keluar serta periksa telemetri, log, konektor, backup dan dukungan jarak jauh. Tinjau kapasitas perangkat, kualitas model, pemeliharaan dan hak akses. Pengunduhan model serta pembaruan dapat dikendalikan terpisah dari pemrosesan dokumen produksi. Sesuai informasi pembicara, RSM Indonesia telah membantu beberapa klien di Indonesia menerapkan AI on-premise. Jangan mengungkap identitas klien atau mengarang hasil terukur.

RAG di dalam alur yang sama:
Jelaskan RAG memakai kebijakan kredit internal. Dokumen berizin diproses dan dibuat indeks pencariannya. Saat ada pertanyaan, retriever menemukan potongan relevan yang boleh diakses pengguna, lalu menambahkannya ke masukan model. Repositori asli tidak digantikan bobot model dan RAG tidak memerlukan pelatihan ulang model dasar atas repositori itu. Namun, model TETAP memproses teks yang diambil saat inferensi. RAG sendiri tidak menjamin nihil retensi vendor atau melarang training berdasarkan kebijakan penggunaan data yang berbeda. Layanan inferensi atau embedding cloud masih dapat menerima teks perusahaan. Alur sepenuhnya lokal harus mencakup embedding, retrieval, inferensi dan proses pendukung, dengan filter akses dan log yang aman. Bedakan dari fine-tuning. Jawaban yang memiliki sitasi tetap diverifikasi ke sumber asli.
slides.notesEn:
An on-premises route can keep processing under the organisation’s infrastructure control while retaining a familiar chatbot or agent interface. This is a conservative data-location choice, not a claim that every on-premises system is more secure than every cloud service. Keep retrieval, embeddings, inference and supporting services local; restrict outbound connections and examine telemetry, logs, connectors, backups and remote support. Check hardware capacity, model quality, maintenance and access rights. Model downloads and updates can be controlled separately from production document processing. The RSM presenters confirm that RSM Indonesia has helped several clients in Indonesia implement on-premises AI. Do not identify clients or invent measurable outcomes.

RAG within the same workflow:
Explain RAG using an internal credit policy. First, authorised documents are processed and indexed. At question time, the retriever finds relevant permitted passages, which are added to the model’s input. The original repository is not replaced by model weights and RAG does not require retraining the base model on that repository. However, the model DOES process the retrieved text during inference. RAG alone neither guarantees no provider retention nor prevents training under an unrelated data-use policy. A cloud inference or embedding service can still receive company text. A fully local deployment must include embeddings, retrieval, inference and ancillary processing, with access filtering and secure logs. Distinguish this from fine-tuning. A cited answer still needs verification against the original source.

slides.title: Auditing AI systems
slides.lead: What are we trying to gain confidence in?
slides.notes: Kita beralih dari mengenali alat ke memeriksa proses yang memakai AI. Banyak framework dapat membantu, tetapi tujuan dan lingkupnya berbeda. Gunakan karakteristik trustworthy AI NIST untuk membentuk pertanyaan audit yang mudah dimengerti. Setelah itu gunakan kasus akuntabilitas chatbot dan contoh keputusan kredit Aruna. Internal audit memeriksa; management tetap memiliki proses dan kontrol.

narrative.question: Audit the AI.
narrative.transition: What are we trying to gain confidence in?

slides.notesEn: Define the audit objective before choosing a framework. The IIA, NIST and ISO support different questions. Examine the intended use, affected people, controls and available evidence rather than a generic demonstration.

slides.title: AI governance and audit frameworks
slides.lead: Use a recognised reference to define the question and scope—not as a universal checklist.
items: AI assurance and sound internal-audit practice.
slides.notes:
Pilih kriteria audit sesuai mandat dan konteks. GIAS mengarahkan praktik internal audit; NIST adalah kerangka risiko sukarela; ISO/IEC 42001 menetapkan persyaratan sistem manajemen AI. Ketiganya tidak saling menggantikan. Adopsi ISO atau sertifikasi bukan bukti setiap keluaran model akurat. Konformitas penuh membutuhkan akses persyaratan dan bukti yang memadai, bukan checklist ringkas dari seminar. Peta ini hanya membantu menentukan fungsi referensi.

Pertanyaan: Many frameworks. Different purposes. Penghubung: Use a recognised reference to define the question and scope—not as a universal checklist.

narrative.question: Many frameworks. Different purposes.
narrative.transition: Use a recognised reference to define the question and scope—not as a universal checklist.

slides.notesEn:
The IIA supports internal-audit practice; NIST helps frame AI-specific risks and trustworthy characteristics; ISO/IEC 42001 addresses organisational AI management. These references are not interchangeable or a single certification checklist.

The IIA · Global Internal Audit Standards · 2024: 2024 edition, effective January 2025. References include Standards 4.3, 11.5, 13.2, 14.1–14.4 and 15.2. The deck paraphrases selected implications for internal audit; it does not replace the Standards or prescribe financial-statement audit requirements.

NIST - AI RMF 1.0 - 2023: Voluntary framework: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. Use the 1.0 edition explicitly; it is under revision.

ISO/IEC 42001 · AI management systems · 2023: Official ISO overview of the AI management system standard. Organisational governance requirements are distinct from proof of a model’s accuracy. No certification or clause-by-clause conformance conclusion is made in this seminar.

slides.title: NIST characteristics of trustworthy AI
slides.lead: NIST AI RMF 1.0: reliability is foundational; accountability and transparency run across the other qualities.
slides.notes:
Gunakan tujuh karakteristik NIST AI RMF 1.0 bagian 3 dan Figure 4: valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy-enhanced, fair with harmful bias managed. Valid/reliable digambar sebagai fondasi; accountability/transparency lintas seluruh karakteristik. Klik karakteristik untuk melihat pertanyaan audit dan bukti contoh. Diagram adalah adaptasi pembelajaran berwarna RSM, bukan gambar resmi atau checklist sertifikasi. Kualitas saling terkait dan dapat mempunyai trade-off. Kriteria, ambang uji, risiko serta bobotnya perlu sesuai intended use dan pihak terdampak; memeriksa setiap kotak secara terpisah tidak menjamin trustworthiness. NIST RMF sukarela, bukan standar audit wajib.

Pertanyaan: What does trustworthy AI look like? Penghubung: NIST AI RMF 1.0: reliability is foundational; accountability and transparency run across the other qualities.

narrative.question: What does trustworthy AI look like?
narrative.transition: NIST AI RMF 1.0: reliability is foundational; accountability and transparency run across the other qualities.

slides.notesEn:
Use NIST AI RMF section 3 and Figure 4. Validity and reliability form the foundation, while accountability and transparency span the other characteristics. Select each quality to see an audit question and evidence examples; context and trade-offs remain important.

NIST - AI RMF 1.0 - 2023: Voluntary framework: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. Use the 1.0 edition explicitly; it is under revision.

NIST · Trustworthy AI characteristics: AI RMF 1.0 section 3 and Figure 4. Seven interconnected qualities, with validity/reliability as a foundation and accountability/transparency across the others. Context and trade-offs matter; this is not an audit certification checklist.

slides.title: Case study: EchoLeak in Microsoft 365 Copilot
slides.lead: EchoLeak shows why enterprise AI belongs in the audit universe.
slides.notes: EchoLeak, CVE-2025-32711, adalah kerentanan nyata pada M365 Copilot yang diungkap dan ditangani pada 2025. Email eksternal yang dirancang khusus dapat memengaruhi pemrosesan konteks internal dan membuka jalur pengungkapan informasi. Ini kasus kerentanan, bukan klaim kebocoran pelanggan terkonfirmasi. Implikasi audit adalah sintesis materi: inventarisasi AI yang terhubung, periksa kepercayaan sumber, batas izin, tindakan keluar, log dan pengujian adversarial. Persetujuan produk tidak menggantikan pengawasan atas penggunaannya dalam proses bisnis.
slides.notesEn: EchoLeak, CVE-2025-32711, is a real vulnerability in M365 Copilot, disclosed and remediated in 2025. A crafted external email could influence processing of internal context and enable information disclosure. It is a documented security vulnerability, not a claim of a confirmed customer breach. The audit implication is our synthesis: inventory connected AI, inspect source trust, permission boundaries, outbound actions, logs and adversarial testing. An approved product does not remove the need to examine its configured business use.

narrative.question: An approved AI tool. An untested trust boundary.
narrative.transition: EchoLeak shows why enterprise AI belongs in the audit universe.

slides.evidenceNote: Resolved vulnerability; this case does not establish a confirmed customer breach.

slides.title: Security testing of AI-enabled systems
slides.lead: Business assurance and adversarial testing answer complementary questions.
slides.notes: Audit internal memeriksa tujuan, tata kelola, hasil dan efektivitas kontrol. Pentest AI yang berizin menguji ketahanan batas tersebut terhadap masukan adversarial. Sesuai informasi pembicara, RSM Indonesia memiliki kapabilitas pentest sistem AI dengan pengalaman eksploitasi prompt injection yang telah diuji. Jangan menyatakan RSM menemukan EchoLeak, menyebut klien atau mengarang tingkat keberhasilan. Tetapkan ruang lingkup, izin, akun uji, pengelolaan bukti dan pengujian ulang.
slides.notesEn: Internal audit examines purpose, governance, outcomes and control effectiveness. Authorised AI penetration testing probes whether those boundaries hold against adversarial inputs. RSM Indonesia has an AI-system penetration-testing capability with demonstrated prompt-injection exploitation experience, as supplied by the presenters. Do not imply that RSM discovered EchoLeak, name a client, or invent a success rate. Agree scope, permissions, test accounts, evidence handling and retesting before testing.

narrative.question: Test the AI workflow. Not only the infrastructure.
narrative.transition: Business assurance and adversarial testing answer complementary questions.

slides.title: Using AI in audit
slides.lead: Useful help for the task. Human authority over the result.
slides.notes: Kita sudah membahas AI sebagai objek audit. Sekarang posisikan AI sebagai bantuan auditor: menyusun laporan dan slide, serta menganalisis data atau dokumen. Periksa dulu kerahasiaan dan jalur penggunaan yang diizinkan. Meskipun AI dapat mengerjakan tugas, manusia tetap memiliki hak dan kemampuan untuk memeriksa, mengubah, menolak dan menghentikan. Dari sini bergerak ke ide yang melampaui pekerjaan harian.

narrative.question: Audit with AI.
narrative.transition: Useful help for the task. Human authority over the result.

slides.notesEn: Now use AI to help the auditor. Reports, slides and analysis can benefit from assistance, but confidentiality and human authority govern the work. The next question is whether the same capability can support a useful repeatable system.

slides.title: AI for reports, presentations and data analysis
slides.lead: Start with the work you already need to do.
items: Structure, summarise and improve the wording.
Turn checked findings into a clear story.
Compare rules, inspect patterns and surface questions.
slides.notes:
Bahas umum, bukan tutorial prompt atau mereview 40 file secara panjang. AI dapat membantu draf laporan, presentasi dan analisis data/dokumen. Studi HBS/BCG pada 758 konsultan mendukung manfaat tugas tertentu dalam capability frontier: lebih dari 25 persen lebih cepat dan lebih dari 40 persen kualitas dinilai manusia. Ini bukan bukti akurasi audit atau penghematan semua engagement. PCAOB 2024 adalah observasi historis staff, bukan aturan universal. Pertanyaan berikutnya adalah informasi apa yang boleh dipakai untuk tugas tersebut.

Pertanyaan: Reports. Slides. Data and document analysis. Penghubung: Start with the work you already need to do.
slides.evidenceNote: HBS/BCG: 758 consultants; task-specific gains within the tested frontier. Not an audit-accuracy benchmark.

narrative.question: Reports. Slides. Data and document analysis.
narrative.transition: Start with the work you already need to do.

slides.notesEn:
AI can help organise a report, turn checked findings into slides, and analyse approved records. A missing approval record is a reason to investigate; it does not prove approval never occurred. Check sources, assumptions and the destination of the output.

HBS / BCG field experiment - 2023: 758 BCG consultants; knowledge-work tasks using GPT-4. Benefits refer to tasks inside the tested capability frontier, not audit accuracy.

PCAOB staff · GenAI outreach · 2024: July 2024 staff observations from limited U.S. audit-firm and preparer outreach, especially pp. 4–5. Historical practice evidence, not a Board rule, a current adoption survey, or Indonesian audit requirements.

slides.title: Set up an audit agent on your computer
slides.lead: One scoped workspace: instructions, skills, evidence and approved templates.
slides.notes:
Contoh fiktif audit perubahan limit kredit. Di komputer, buat workspace khusus, kumpulkan hanya bukti yang diizinkan, hubungkan agent ke folder tersebut, aktifkan skill review kredit dan lampirkan template kertas kerja serta register temuan. Tampilkan contoh audit-rules.md: scope 40 perubahan, referensikan E01/E02/E03, jangan mengarang bukti, simpan hanya ke output/drafts dan minta review sebelum penerbitan. Skill berisi prosedur berulang, template menentukan bentuk keluaran, dan scripts/reconcile.py adalah tool untuk pengujian deterministik yang diizinkan. Penemuan dan registrasi skill mengikuti produk yang dipakai; folder contoh bukan jaminan skill otomatis aktif. Label READ ONLY harus ditegakkan melalui izin tool atau sandbox. Folder lokal tidak membuktikan model offline; periksa persetujuan pemrosesan, retensi dan lokasi inference. Visual adalah ilustrasi, bukan screenshot aplikasi atau hasil implementasi klien.

Sources: https://agentskills.io/specification ; https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/
slides.notesEn:
Fictional credit-limit audit example. Open an approved local workspace in the agent, register its credit-review skill according to the chosen product, attach the working-paper and findings templates, and grant only the necessary file tools. Scope the task to 40 changes, require evidence references and missing-evidence flags, and write drafts only. A skill supplies a repeatable procedure; templates supply output structure; a permitted script can perform deterministic reconciliation. Folder names and instructions do not enforce permissions. A local workspace does not imply local model inference or approved confidential processing. This is an illustrative setup, not a product screenshot.

Sources: https://agentskills.io/specification ; https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/

narrative.question: Set up an audit agent on your computer
narrative.transition: One scoped workspace: instructions, skills, evidence and approved templates.

slides.title: Watch the evidence become a reviewable draft
slides.lead: Read-only inputs / skill and tools / cited draft / auditor review.
slides.notes:
Jelaskan animasi dari kiri ke kanan. Agent membaca kebijakan E01, register E02 dan bukti E03; menjalankan prosedur skill dan tool rekonsiliasi; lalu mengisi template menjadi working-paper.docx dan exception-register.xlsx. Contoh exception06: E01 pasal4.2 mensyaratkan persetujuan independen, E02 baris18 berisi perubahan, E03 tidak memuat bukti cocok dalam paket. Output harus menyatakan bukti belum diberikan dan meminta klarifikasi, bukan menyatakan fraud. Auditor memeriksa rujukan dan interpretasi, meminta revisi bila perlu, dan reviewer berwenang menyetujui penerbitan. Hanya versi disetujui dipindah ke output/reviewed oleh manusia. Animasi ilustratif, bukan eksekusi file atau klaim hasil aktual. Gunakan Pause atau Replay; mode reduced motion menampilkan semua tahap statis.

Sources: https://agentskills.io/specification ; https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/
slides.notesEn:
Walk through the animation: read E01 policy, E02 change register and E03 approvals; apply the review skill and permitted reconciliation tools; fill the approved templates; stop at the auditor review gate. Exception 06 cites policy section 4.2 and register row 18; the supplied approval pack contains no matching record. The draft requests clarification rather than inferring fraud. Auditor/reviewer checks, corrects, rejects or approves; only an approved version is moved to output/reviewed by a person. Pause and Replay support teaching, and reduced-motion mode shows all steps statically. This is a conceptual animation, not a live run or measured result.

Sources: https://agentskills.io/specification ; https://openai.com/business/guides-and-resources/a-practical-guide-to-building-ai-agents/

narrative.transition: Read-only inputs / skill and tools / cited draft / auditor review.

slides.title: Confidential data in AI-assisted audit work
slides.lead: A no-training switch alone is not permission to share a client document.
slides.notes:
Pola praktik yang disarankan, bukan sebuah standar formal bernama gold standard: kewenangan dan klasifikasi data ditetapkan, tool/account/processor disetujui, ketentuan training/retensi/lokasi/akses sesuai kebutuhan, scope dan informasi diminimalkan, serta output diperiksa. Bila lingkungan belum disetujui untuk raw confidential data, gunakan schema/contoh fiktif untuk meminta metode, rumus atau kode. Orang yang kompeten meninjau dan menguji lalu menjalankannya sendiri pada lingkungan lokal tepercaya, dengan data asli di luar akses agen; hanya ringkasan yang disetujui dibagikan bila diizinkan. Bukan cloud code interpreter atau command agen yang mengirim stdout mentah ke model. Model lokal/offline hanya boleh diklaim jika seluruh alur benar-benar diverifikasi. Redaksi dan agregasi dapat tetap mengungkap informasi. Bila tidak dapat dipenuhi, jangan kirim dokumen tersebut.

Pertanyaan: Confidential work? Use an approved path. Penghubung: A no-training switch alone is not permission to share a client document.

narrative.question: Confidential work? Use an approved path.
narrative.transition: A no-training switch alone is not permission to share a client document.

slides.notesEn:
For confidential work, confirm authority and an approved processing environment with appropriate terms, access and retention controls. If raw records are not approved for upload, request a method using made-up data and run reviewed checks yourself on trusted local tools outside agent access.

OpenAI · ChatGPT Work enterprise overview: Enterprise/Edu Work documentation: conversations, uploaded files, memory and connected sources can have distinct retention and deletion lifecycles. Not a universal consumer ChatGPT or API policy.

OpenAI · API data controls: API-specific documentation reviewed 13 November 2026: API data is not used for training by default unless opted in. Retention and processing controls are separate. Do not apply this statement to every personal chatbot account or feature.

OWASP · Sensitive data disclosure · 2025: LLM02:2025. Data sanitisation, least privilege, source restriction and disclosure risk. A control in a prompt or a redaction step is not a complete privacy guarantee.

OpenAI · Agent approvals & security: Product-specific guidance on agent permissions, sandboxing and command networking. Shell restrictions do not establish offline model inference or cover every hosted search, app or MCP path. Diagrams simplify these distinctions for general audiences; they do not reproduce the exact interface.

slides.title: Human authority and human-in-the-loop controls
slides.lead: Decide what can run automatically, what needs review, and what must stop for approval.
slides.notes:
Human in the loop bukan sekadar tombol setuju di akhir. Definisikan keputusan, materialitas, kompetensi reviewer, hak mengubah/menolak dan kondisi berhenti. AI bisa menyiapkan langkah atau bahkan menyelesaikan banyak task di dalam izin. Scope audit, penerimaan kriteria, kesimpulan, laporan dan respons risiko tetap memerlukan pihak yang berwenang. Review harus memeriksa bukti, bukan hanya bahasa yang rapi. Jangan menempatkan auditor sebagai pemilik keputusan manajemen. Tunjukkan konsep ini lagi saat approve annual plan, programme, report dan risk review.

Pertanyaan: AI can do the task. People keep the authority. Penghubung: Decide what can run automatically, what needs review, and what must stop for approval.

narrative.question: AI can do the task. People keep the authority.
narrative.transition: Decide what can run automatically, what needs review, and what must stop for approval.

slides.notesEn:
AI may prepare a draft or propose an action. A person must be able to inspect sources, challenge assumptions, change the result, reject it or stop. Approval without time, competence or genuine discretion is not meaningful human authority.

The IIA · Global Internal Audit Standards · 2024: 2024 edition, effective January 2025. References include Standards 4.3, 11.5, 13.2, 14.1–14.4 and 15.2. The deck paraphrases selected implications for internal audit; it does not replace the Standards or prescribe financial-statement audit requirements.

NIST - Generative AI Profile - 2024: Cross-sector guidance on generative AI risks; not proof that a particular product is safe.

OpenAI · Agent approvals & security: Product-specific guidance on agent permissions, sandboxing and command networking. Shell restrictions do not establish offline model inference or cover every hosted search, app or MCP path. Diagrams simplify these distinctions for general audiences; they do not reproduce the exact interface.

slides.title: AI for repeatable workflows and applications
slides.lead: The same capability can help build a dashboard, a repeatable programme or a whole application.
slides.notes:
Pindah dari output sekali pakai ke kapabilitas yang dipakai ulang. Contoh: dashboard yang menyatukan exception, workflow pengumpulan evidence, dan sistem assurance. AI dapat membantu spesifikasi, kode, pengujian, dokumentasi dan antarmuka, tetapi akses data, kualitas, operasional, keamanan dan maintainability tetap pekerjaan nyata. Jangan mengatakan semua ide otomatis layak produksi atau tidak membutuhkan kompetensi manusia.

Pertanyaan: Beyond the daily assistant. Penghubung: The same capability can help build a dashboard, a repeatable programme or a whole application.

narrative.question: Beyond the daily assistant.
narrative.transition: The same capability can help build a dashboard, a repeatable programme or a whole application.

slides.notesEn:
Separate an individual output from a capability people keep using. AI can help create a dashboard, programme or application. Testing, ownership, security, maintenance and adoption remain part of the job.

Anthropic · Building effective agents · 2024: Engineering guidance distinguishing predefined workflows from model-directed tool use. Used for the architectural distinction, not a benchmark, audit standard or claim that autonomy is always preferable.

RSM · Middle Market AI Survey · 2026: U.S./Canada study: 1,030 respondents from organisations already using AI, including pilots. The 86% integration and 36% fully-embedded figures describe this sample; they do not measure adoption across all businesses or in Indonesia.

slides.title: AI and the idea–execution–usage gap
slides.lead: AI opens up what we can imagine and build. Actual use is a separate test.
slides.notes: Gunakan ilustrasi kerumunan ini untuk membuka paradoks, bukan membacakan diagram proses. Sebelum AI, sedikit orang menginisiasi ide, lebih banyak orang terlibat dalam eksekusi, dan banyak orang memakai hasilnya. Dengan AI, lebih banyak orang dapat menghasilkan ide serta membangun. Pertanyaan yang sengaja dibuat mencolok: siapa yang benar-benar akan memakai hasilnya? Figur dan distribusinya adalah metafora konseptual, bukan hitungan responden, prediksi penurunan pengguna, atau hasil studi HBS/RSM. Jangan membandingkan jumlah figur sebagai statistik. Gambar terinspirasi arah visual referensi yang diberikan presenter, tetapi digambar ulang khusus untuk deck dengan identitas RSM. Tekankan: eksekusi aman tetap perlu usaha; ide yang berguna, adopsi, dan hasil nyata tetap harus diuji. Survei RSM pada slide berikut memberi bukti terpisah tentang perbedaan integrasi, bukan bukti jumlah figur di sini.
slides.evidenceNote: Conceptual metaphor. The figures illustrate a shift in constraints; they are not survey counts or measured before/after results.

narrative.question: Building becomes easier. Usefulness still has to be earned.
narrative.transition: If more of us can build, how do we choose something people will actually use?

slides.notesEn:
The crowds are a conceptual metaphor, not measured populations or before/after research. AI can lower barriers to imagining and building, while useful adoption still needs to be earned. Do not interpret the smaller usage crowd as evidence that AI reduces adoption.

HBS / BCG field experiment - 2023: 758 BCG consultants; knowledge-work tasks using GPT-4. Benefits refer to tasks inside the tested capability frontier, not audit accuracy.

RSM · Middle Market AI Survey · 2026: U.S./Canada study: 1,030 respondents from organisations already using AI, including pilots. The 86% integration and 36% fully-embedded figures describe this sample; they do not measure adoption across all businesses or in Indonesia.

RSM · Survey methodology · 2026: Fieldwork 5–16 March 2026: 827 U.S. and 203 Canadian respondents, management level or above with influence over technology investment. Government and nonprofits excluded. All participating organisations already used AI.

slides.title: Business analysis turns AI ideas into business value
slides.lead: Curate the business need. Design the right system. Prove the value.
slides.notes:
Membuat prototipe chatbot relatif mudah. Menghasilkan nilai nyata bagi perusahaan memerlukan business analyst untuk mengkurasi kebutuhan, memahami pengguna dan proses, menyepakati batasan serta memprioritaskan masalah yang layak didanai. Bersama tim bisnis dan teknologi, kebutuhan diterjemahkan menjadi alur kerja, kebutuhan data, kontrol dan acceptance criteria yang bisa diuji. Tentukan pemilik, baseline manfaat dan biaya operasi; uji pilot sebelum memperluas investasi agar sumber daya tidak terbuang.

Vibe coding di berbagai level pegawai atau kantor cabang dapat memperbanyak shadow IT bila tidak disertai governance. Parameter akses, pengelolaan secret, perlindungan data dan konfigurasi keamanan bisa berbeda-beda. Sediakan intake dan inventaris aplikasi, platform yang disetujui, baseline keamanan, pemilik, review dan kontrol rilis. Business analyst membantu menyelaraskan kebutuhan dan nilai; tim teknologi serta keamanan tetap bertanggung jawab atas desain dan assurance teknis. IIBA dan OWASP menjadi rujukan konsep, bukan bukti angka penghematan tertentu.

narrative.question: A chatbot is easy to build. A useful business system takes more.
narrative.transition: Curate the business need. Design the right system. Prove the value.

slides.notesEn:
A chatbot prototype is relatively easy to build. Delivering company value requires business analysis: understand users and processes, prioritise a worthwhile need, define constraints and agree testable acceptance criteria with business and technology teams. Establish an owner, expected benefit, baseline and operating cost. Pilot the use case before scaling the investment.

AI-assisted development across employees and branches can expand shadow IT without shared governance. Access, secret handling, data protection and security settings may be inconsistent. Use a common intake, application inventory, approved platforms, security baseline, named owners and review/release controls. Business analysts connect needs to value; technology and security teams retain technical design and assurance responsibilities. IIBA and OWASP support these concepts. No quantified savings or automatic security guarantee is claimed.

slides.title: Agentic AI in audit and continuous risk assurance
slides.lead: From survey evidence to a human-governed model, then a practical demonstration.
slides.notes: Perkenalkan satu usulan terintegrasi: agentic AI mendukung perencanaan, fieldwork dan pelaporan audit; hasil audit dan sinyal lain menjadi masukan assurance risiko berkelanjutan. Mulai dari survei, jelaskan model terintegrasi serta persetujuan manusia, lalu demonstrasikan langkah terpilih di dua ruang kerja contoh. Saran disiapkan sebelumnya, bukan sistem otonom yang terhubung.

narrative.question: Agentic AI in audit and continuous risk assurance
narrative.transition: From survey evidence to a human-governed model, then a practical demonstration.

slides.notesEn: Introduce one integrated proposal: agentic AI supports audit planning, fieldwork and reporting, while audit results and other signals feed continuous risk assurance. Begin with the strategic-value and audit-alignment surveys, explain the connected model and human approval gates, then demonstrate selected steps in the two dummy workspaces. The workspaces use prepared suggestions rather than a connected autonomous system.

slides.title: Strategic value of risk management
slides.lead: Risk reporting is not the same as strategic value.
items: did not report a unique strategic advantage from risk management.
slides.notes: Hanya 11% melaporkan keunggulan strategis atau kompetitif yang unik dari manajemen risiko. Komplemen yang dibulatkan adalah 89%; bukan berarti 89% gagal atau tidak memperoleh manfaat sama sekali. Ini persepsi responden, bukan uji kausal dan bukan bukti khusus Indonesia. Tanyakan apakah bukti baru benar-benar mengubah prioritas, keputusan risiko dan tindakan di antara siklus pelaporan.

narrative.question: Strategic value of risk management
narrative.transition: Risk reporting is not the same as strategic value.

slides.notesEn: Only 11% reported a unique strategic or competitive advantage from risk management. The rounded complement is 89%; it does not mean that 89% failed or obtained no benefit. This is self-reported survey evidence, not a causal test and not evidence specific to Indonesia. Ask whether new evidence actually changes priorities, risk decisions and action between reporting cycles.
slides.surveyContrast: Only 11% reported a unique strategic or competitive advantage.
slides.surveyScope: 331 executive / board respondents · Q2 2026. Rounded complement of 11%; self-reported perceptions, not a failure rate.

slides.title: Alignment of internal audit and risk management
slides.lead: An audit finding should inform a shared view of risk.
items: of business executives perceived an alignment gap.
slides.notesEn: PwC reports that 49% of business executives perceived a lack of strong alignment between internal audit and other lines on key risks and problems. The overall study includes 4,680 respondents across 81 countries, but that total is not the denominator for this subgroup result. It measures perceived alignment, not audit failure. The practical question is whether a reviewed finding reaches the risk owner and changes a decision about the objective.
slides.notes: PwC melaporkan bahwa 49% eksekutif bisnis menilai audit internal belum selaras kuat dengan lini lain dalam risiko dan masalah utama. Studi keseluruhan mencakup 4.680 responden di 81 negara, tetapi jumlah itu bukan penyebut hasil subkelompok ini. Ukurannya adalah persepsi keselarasan, bukan kegagalan audit. Pertanyaan praktisnya: apakah temuan yang direviu sampai kepada pemilik risiko dan mengubah keputusan terkait tujuan?

narrative.question: Alignment of internal audit and risk management

slides.notes: Dua survei menunjukkan celah berbeda: nilai strategis manajemen risiko dan keselarasan audit internal dengan lini lain. Usulan ini menghubungkan pekerjaan, bukan menambah lapisan laporan. Mulai dari tujuan, register risiko dan toleransi. AI mengusulkan prioritas audit; pimpinan audit menyetujui lingkup. AI membantu pelaksanaan program, tetapi auditor memvalidasi bukti dan reviewer mengesahkan laporan. Laporan yang direviu menjadi satu sinyal bersama memo atau risalah serta berita atau media sosial. AI menilai relevansi dan mengusulkan respons; pemilik risiko menerima, mengubah atau menolaknya. Pantau dampak aktual dan gunakan bukti risiko terbaru untuk rencana audit berikutnya. Mitigasi yang direncanakan belum berarti penurunan yang tercapai. Dua slide berikut merinci perencanaan dan fieldwork; setelah itu perjelas hak keputusan manusia sebelum demo langkah terpilih di ruang kerja contoh yang terpisah. Ini model operasi usulan, bukan integrasi otonom yang sudah berjalan.
slides.notesEn: The two surveys expose different gaps: strategic value from risk management and alignment of internal audit with other lines. This proposal connects the work rather than adding another reporting layer. Start with objectives, registered risks and tolerance. AI proposes audit priorities; the audit lead approves scope. AI supports programme execution, but auditors validate evidence and the reviewer authorises reporting. The reviewed report becomes one signal alongside memos or minutes and news or social media. AI checks relevance and proposes a risk response; the risk owner accepts, changes or rejects it. Monitor actual effects and feed updated risk evidence into the next audit plan. A planned mitigation is not an achieved reduction. The next two slides unpack planning and fieldwork; then clarify human decision rights before demonstrating selected steps in separate dummy workspaces. This is a proposed operating model, not a claim of a live autonomous integration.

slides.lead: AI connects risk evidence to the audit universe; people approve the portfolio.
slides.notes: Konsep sebelum demo. Mulai dari strategi dan objek audit, lalu agregasikan risiko, perubahan, bukti kontrol dan kesenjangan cakupan. AI dapat mengekstrak dan mengaitkan bukti, mengusulkan prioritas yang dapat ditelusuri serta alternatif portofolio dengan batas kompetensi dan kapasitas. Bobot 40/20/20/20 dan prioritas 86/72/58 adalah asumsi pembelajaran, bukan hasil riset atau formula IIA. Sisihkan sepuluh dari enam puluh hari untuk pekerjaan wajib; tiga puluh ditambah dua puluh hari menggunakan kapasitas sisanya. Jelaskan penundaan audit cabang dan pantau kesenjangan cakupan. Validasi kualitas sumber dan informasi yang belum tersedia sebelum persetujuan; perbarui saat ada perubahan material. Konsep ini lebih luas daripada demo yang sengaja disederhanakan.
slides.notesEn: Concept before the demonstration. Begin with strategy and auditable objects, then aggregate risk, change, control evidence and coverage gaps. AI can extract and relate evidence, propose a traceable priority and suggest alternative portfolios under skill and capacity limits. The displayed 40/20/20/20 weights and 86/72/58 priorities are teaching assumptions, not calculated research or an IIA formula. Reserve ten of sixty days for mandatory work; thirty plus twenty days then fits the remaining capacity. Explain why a branch review is deferred and monitor the residual coverage gap. Validate source quality and missing information before approval; refresh after material changes. This concept is broader than the deliberately simple demonstration.

slides.title: AI in audit fieldwork
slides.lead: AI connects the work; auditors validate the criteria, evidence and conclusion.
slides.notes: Bawa tujuan dan risiko yang telah disetujui ke penugasan. AI mengusulkan program, sumber kriteria, permintaan bukti dan penugasan auditor. Reviewer memvalidasi versi referensi dan relevansinya sebelum pengujian. Dalam contoh audit kredit ini diperiksa 1.240 pesanan; 18 catatan tidak memiliki lampiran persetujuan. Auditor menelusuri dan menemukan bukti sah untuk enam catatan, sehingga tersisa dua belas pengecualian terkonfirmasi. Flag dari model belum menjadi temuan. Rekam metode, populasi, tautan bukti dan keterbatasan; telusuri akar sebab dan konfirmasi respons manajemen. Laporan dan slide hanya disusun dari fakta yang telah direviu. Ini bukan penugasan klien atau klaim tingkat kejadian. Demo berikut mewakili logika ini dengan lebih sedikit objek dan catatan.
slides.notesEn: Carry the approved objective and risk into the engagement. AI proposes a programme, source criteria, evidence requests and auditor assignments. Reviewers validate reference versions and relevance before testing. In this illustrative credit audit, 1,240 orders are examined; 18 records lack attached approval evidence. The auditor investigates and locates valid evidence for six, leaving twelve confirmed exceptions. The model’s flags are therefore not findings. Record the method, population, evidence links and limitations; investigate root cause and confirm management responses. Generate the report and slides only from reviewed facts. The example is not a client engagement and does not claim a prevalence rate. The following demo represents this logic with fewer objects and records.

Buka alert per risiko dan semua signal yang dipetakan ke risiko itu. Baca summary, why dan source. Accept/decline tiap signal; alasan penolakan tidak dipaksakan peritem. Setelah seluruhnya diputus, analisis saran likelihood/impact berdasarkan evidence yang diterima. Unverified social lead sendiri tidak menyebabkan suggested increase. OWASP · Prompt injection · 2025: LLM01:2025. Untrusted content can redirect an LLM application; controls must address the application, tools and permissions rather than relying on a system prompt alone.
